Batch crawl of 2 seed URLs with links to discover

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { batchCrawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const urls = ["https://example.com/seed1", "https://example.com/seed2"];
  const result = await batchCrawl(engine, urls);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
